name: claude-connector
description: Delegate bounded, git-scoped review and coding tasks to the local Claude Code CLI from Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, or Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate reviews and tasks to Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Delegate bounded, git-scoped review and coding tasks to the local Claude Code CLI from Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, or Antigravity. Review is the default mode, runs with a read-only tool profile, and returns a schema-validated verdict with findings.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude Code to review my uncommitted changes.
Delegate this diagnosis to Claude Code.
